Download the desktop installer for your platform. RStudio also needs an installation of [R](https://cloud.r-project.org/), which most systems do not come with; on Windows, nothing else is required.

The new, free IDE for data science with R and Python from Posit. [Download free &rarr;](https://positron.posit.co/download.html)

## <img src="images/posit-icon-fullcolor.svg" alt="" width="20" height="20" style="vertical-align: -0.2em;"> Add AI to RStudio

[Posit Assistant](https://pos.it/assistant) is a set of AI features available as a downloadable extension for RStudio, with Posit AI as the recommended model provider. [Set it up &rarr;](ide/guide/tools/posit-ai.qmd)
:::

For installation and configuration of the commercial editions, see the [RStudio Desktop Pro installation guide](https://docs.posit.co/ide/desktop-pro/getting_started/installation.html) and, for RStudio inside [Posit Workbench](https://posit.co/products/enterprise/workbench/), the [Posit Workbench installation guide](https://docs.posit.co/rsw/installation/).

::: {.callout-warning}

### Daily Builds

[RStudio Daily builds](https://dailies.rstudio.com/) are intended for testing purposes, and are not recommended for general use. For stable builds, please use one of the above links for Open Source or Commercial downloads.

:::
